Step 1 of 8: Identify the two blue Cat5e cables
Locate the two blue Cat5e cables currently punched into the existing phone distribution block (the black multi-port strip in the center of the panel). Trace each one to confirm it is a Cat5e cable and not a coax or phone line.
Do not touch: coax splitter (the silver metal box at the top) · coax cables (the thick black cables with screw-on metal ends) · yellow-green wire at the bottom (this is a ground wire — leave it alone)
Stop if: If either cable feels warm, smells, or shows any scorching or melted insulation, stop and contact a professional.
Next photo must show: A photo clearly showing both blue Cat5e cables and where they enter the block, so the starting point is confirmed.
